definitions.gloss: low quality; poor quality; inferior quality
definitions.explanation: A low standard of quality — of goods, services, content, or work. Used both as a noun and, with の, as a modifier meaning low-quality or inferior.

examples.japanese: {低品質|ていひんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧。
⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{低品質|ていひんしつ}なら⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れる→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: Even if it's cheap, a low-quality product will break quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低品質|ていひんしつ}な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, low-quality information has been increasing online.

examples.japanese: {低品質|ていひんしつ}な⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信頼性|しんらいせい}→信頼性：05572_shinraisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がって→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Using low-quality parts reduces the reliability of the whole product.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧ (low) and ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧ (quality). Describes goods, services, content, or work of inferior standard. The direct antonym is ⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧ (high quality).

USAGE:
- As a noun: {低品質|ていひんしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ (the low quality is a problem)
- As a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-modifier: {低品質|ていひんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧ (low-quality parts)
- Also used as a な-adjective: {低品質|ていひんしつ}な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ (low-quality information)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低品質|ていひんしつ}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: a low-quality product
- {低品質|ていひんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: poor-quality service
- {低品質|ていひんしつ}⟦コンテンツ→コンテンツ：06234_kontentsu⟧: low-quality content (often online)
- {低品質|ていひんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧: to improve poor quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧: high quality — the direct antonym
- ⟦{粗悪|そあく}→粗悪：18175_soaku⟧: poor, shoddy — stronger and more negative; often implies deliberately inferior goods
- ⟦{劣悪|れつあく}→劣悪：11917_retsuaku⟧: inferior, abysmal — even stronger; used for conditions or quality that is dangerously bad
- ⟦{安物|やすもの}→安物：22116_yasumono⟧: cheap thing — refers to the product itself rather than its quality level
